summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LLM Command Interpreter app. All backend APIs and frontend features working perfectly. Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration successful.
passed_tests: Chat interface loads with dark theme
Empty state shows example prompts correctly
Chat input field accepts and processes commands
Multi-command processing (e.g., 'go to grids, create table, apply borders' -> 'Grids.Table.Borders')
Formula output displays with professional styling
Copy button copies formula to clipboard
Example prompt buttons work when clicked
Chat history displays user messages and AI responses
Formula breakdown shows numbered steps for multi-commands
Input validation (send button disabled for empty input)
Professional dark theme UI with glass effects and gradients
Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration via emergentintegrations library
Session management and chat history persistence
Error handling for invalid commands (returns UNKNOWN_COMMAND)
